title: The arena referee's facts.jsonl events, a facts v1 extension
description: The three events the harness writes from the referee (harness-only, never seen by either agent) into a match's one facts.jsonl, next to the facts v1 records (packages/harness/schemas/facts.v1.schema.json: v, kind, t, game_t, at). bg3bench.arena.grade reads them. Sides are A and B; a player is the model a side's client plays ("<client>/<model slug>", as the pairing planner names it).

then.description: The match began: once, after the arena setup and before the first turn.

seed.description: the dice seed the mod applied

teams.description: each side's characters, in the arena file's order

then.description: A character's turn began (the game's TurnStarted).

The match ended: once. wipe: every character of the loser is down or dead at a turn boundary; round_cap, wall_cap: the higher HP fraction wins, an exact tie is a draw (winner null); abort, fault: the harness ended it (an invalid match).

hp_left_A.description: side A's summed current HP over its summed max HP

hp_left_B.description: side B's summed current HP over its summed max HP
